verdict.rationale: Docs confirm official mobile SDKs (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter upcoming) as direct replacements for Onfido Smart Capture SDKs, plus API/SDK token issuance, OAuth-based authentication, webhook configuration, and a migration guide for developers building against these SDKs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration, and evidence of broader server-side/language SDKs beyond mobile.
